purpose: Independent quality gate for the full character redraw batch; does not mutate frozen generation prompts or job hashes.

baseline.qualityReferenceRule: Use the user-provided Albina baseline and its de-identified style board as the visual quality standard. Existing generated deliveries are evidence under review, never quality references.

criticalFailures: extra or missing limb, hand, finger, foot, toe, joint, or duplicated feature
impossible pose, unsupported weight, broken contact, impossible occlusion, or disconnected prop
identity drift, side assignment drift, canon/AU boundary drift, or continuity break
style-board mismatch in line density, flat-to-painterly balance, material edge treatment, palette, or industrial cold-light direction
crop, scale-anchor, alpha, watermark, text, logo, or Live2D-splitting failure

criteria.label: 人体结构
checks: Visible hands have five countable, naturally separated digits with plausible joints and fingertip order.
Visible feet have coherent volume, toe order, ankle and weight-bearing geometry.
Shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles, neck and spine form one continuous articulated body.
No fused fingers, impossible joints, duplicated limbs, disconnected hands, twisted torso, or floating anatomy.

criteria.label: 物理与接触
checks: The pose has a plausible center of mass and support polygon.
Hands visibly connect to tools, weapons, frames, or clothing and the grip/contact is physically coherent.
Layered clothing, armor, hair cables, straps and props have consistent occlusion and attachment boundaries.
Long objects have a coherent axis, perspective, thickness, and point of contact; no impossible floating or interpenetration.

criteria.label: 身份连续性
checks: Required canon or AU anchors are present and readable at 100 percent.
Image-left/image-right eye and side assignments remain correct where applicable.
Variants change only the requested emotion, wardrobe, tool, lighting, or pose while retaining the same identity and scale anchors.
No accidental borrowing of face, body, costume, prop, or pose from another character.

criteria.label: 基准画风
checks: Dense precise 2D linework matches the baseline board rather than a smooth 3D, doll-like, glossy, or generic anime treatment.
Flat-color transitions and restrained painterly shading match the board's balance.
Cool white/charcoal structure, restrained gold, warning red, biomechanical edges, and industrial cold light remain coherent.
No text, logo, watermark, faux UI, or visual-language drift.

criteria.label: 交付完整性
checks: 1024x1536 transparent PNG; full head-to-shoe figure is present without crop.
Center, shoe baseline, head clearance, and side margins match the shared portrait anchors.
Silhouette and boundaries are suitable for later Live2D layer separation.
Transparent pixels contain no residual chroma-key RGB contamination.

evidenceRequired: hand and foot crops where visible
comparison against the user-provided baseline style board
reviewRecordRule: Every decision must name each criterion as passed or failed and include evidence; a missing evidence item is not an approval.
